quests.instruction: When do we see or do this: "A cash register beeping steadily as a line of shoppers waits to pay"?
quests.hint: Think about when stores are usually busiest with shoppers.
quests.explanation: Yes! Stores are usually busiest with shoppers during the day.
quests.funFact: The very first cash registers were invented to help stop employees from secretly taking money!

quests.instruction: "A vending machine humming alone in an empty office hallway" — when does this happen?
quests.hint: Think about when an office hallway would be completely empty.
quests.explanation: Yes! An empty office hallway suggests everyone has gone home for the night.
quests.funFact: Vending machines keep running all day and all night, even when no one's around!

quests.instruction: "A dog groomer trimming a poodle's fur in a bright, busy salon" — when does this happen?
quests.hint: Think about when pet salons are usually open for appointments.
quests.explanation: Yes! Pet grooming salons are typically open and busy during the day.
quests.funFact: Some dog breeds need a professional grooming appointment every few weeks!

quests.instruction: When do we see or do this: "A cat's silhouette perched on a windowsill, watching the empty street"?
quests.hint: Think about when a street would be completely empty, with no one around.
quests.explanation: Yes! An empty street suggests it's late, at night.
quests.funFact: Cats are known for loving a good spot by the window to watch the world go by!

quests.instruction: Think about this: "Kids trading stickers and comparing lunches at a cafeteria table". Does it happen in the Daytime or the Nighttime?
quests.hint: Think about when the school cafeteria is full of students eating lunch.
quests.explanation: Yes! The school cafeteria is busy with students during school hours.
quests.funFact: Trading snacks and stickers is a fun way kids build friendships at lunchtime!

quests.instruction: "A half-eaten sandwich left on a desk in a dim, empty office" — when does this happen?
quests.hint: Think about the word 'dim' — what does that tell you about the office lighting?
quests.explanation: Yes! A dim, empty office suggests everyone has already gone home for the night.
quests.funFact: Many offices dim their lights automatically once everyone has left for the day!

quests.instruction: You notice this happening: "A mechanic rolling out from under a car to grab a different wrench". What time of day is it?
quests.hint: Think about when an auto shop is usually open for repairs.
quests.explanation: Yes! Auto repair shops are typically open and working during the day.
quests.funFact: Mechanics use hundreds of different tools to fix all kinds of car troubles!

quests.instruction: You notice this happening: "A single lamp glowing in an otherwise dark apartment building". What time of day is it?
quests.hint: Think about when an apartment building would look mostly dark, except for one window.
quests.explanation: Yes! A mostly dark building with one glowing lamp suggests it's late at night.
quests.funFact: A single lit window can make a whole building look cozy against the dark night sky!

quests.instruction: When do we see or do this: "A barista steaming milk for a long line of customers"?
quests.hint: Think about when coffee shops usually have their longest lines.
quests.explanation: Yes! Coffee shops are often busiest with long lines during the day.
quests.funFact: Steamed milk is heated using hot pressurized air called steam!

quests.instruction: When do we see or do this: "A parking garage nearly empty except for a few scattered cars"?
quests.hint: Think about when a busy parking garage would finally be nearly empty.
quests.explanation: Yes! A nearly empty parking garage suggests most people have already gone home for the night.
quests.funFact: Parking garages are usually busiest during the workday and much emptier overnight!

quests.instruction: "A crossing guard's whistle blowing sharply near a busy intersection" — when does this happen?
quests.hint: Think about when crossing guards are usually on duty near schools.
quests.explanation: Yes! Crossing guards work during school arrival and dismissal times, in the daytime.
quests.funFact: Crossing guards help keep pedestrians safe at some of the busiest intersections!

quests.instruction: "A vending machine's glow the only light in a quiet break room" — when does this happen?
quests.hint: Think about when a break room would be completely quiet, with the lights off.
quests.explanation: Yes! A quiet, dark break room suggests it's late at night.
quests.funFact: A vending machine's glowing buttons often light up the moment you press one!

quests.instruction: Think about this: "A delivery driver double-checking an address against a clipboard". Does it happen in the Daytime or the Nighttime?
quests.hint: Think about when most package deliveries are usually made.
quests.explanation: Yes! Most deliveries are made during the day.
quests.funFact: Some delivery companies now use special apps instead of paper clipboards!

quests.instruction: When do we see or do this: "A dog's collar jingling softly as it settles onto its bed"?
quests.hint: Think about when a dog would finally settle down onto its bed to rest.
quests.explanation: Yes! A dog settling onto its bed to rest suggests it's nighttime.
quests.funFact: Dogs often turn in a circle a few times before lying down — it's an old instinct!

quests.instruction: When do we see or do this: "A choir warming up their voices before a school performance"?
quests.hint: Think about when school performances and assemblies are usually held.
quests.explanation: Yes! School performances are usually held during school hours, in the daytime.
quests.funFact: Singers warm up their voices to help protect them and sound their very best!

quests.instruction: "A phone screen's glow lighting up a dim bedroom ceiling for a moment" — when does this happen?
quests.hint: Think about when a bedroom would already be dim enough for a phone glow to stand out.
quests.explanation: Yes! A dim bedroom suggests it's already night.
quests.funFact: Phone screens can seem extra bright in a dark room, even at a low setting!

quests.instruction: "A librarian reshelving a stack of returned books" — when does this happen?
quests.hint: Think about when libraries are usually open and busy with visitors.
quests.explanation: Yes! Libraries are typically open and active during the day.
quests.funFact: Librarians use a special numbering system to help every book find its exact place on the shelf!

quests.instruction: When do we see or do this: "A stack of dishes finally dried and put away in a quiet kitchen"?
quests.hint: Think about when a kitchen would finally be quiet, with the day's dishes all done.
quests.explanation: Yes! A quiet kitchen with the dishes finally done suggests it's evening, part of the nighttime.
quests.funFact: Finishing the dishes is often one of the very last chores of the day!

quests.instruction: You notice this happening: "A dentist's waiting room filling up with patients". What time of day is it?
quests.hint: Think about when a waiting room would be filling up with daytime appointments.
quests.explanation: Yes! A waiting room full of patients suggests the dentist's office is open during the day.
quests.funFact: Regular dental checkups help catch small problems before they become big ones!

quests.instruction: "A single porch step creaking under a returning cat's paws" — when does this happen?
quests.hint: Think about when an outdoor cat usually comes home to settle in for the evening.
quests.explanation: Yes! A cat returning home like this often happens once it's getting dark, at night.
quests.funFact: Cats are natural explorers and often like to roam a bit before coming home to rest!

quests.instruction: When do we see or do this: "A birthday cake being carried carefully into a rented party hall"?
quests.hint: Think about when children's birthday parties are usually held.
quests.explanation: Yes! Children's birthday parties are usually held during the day.
quests.funFact: Birthday cakes with candles are a tradition in many cultures around the world!

quests.instruction: When do we see or do this: "A half-finished puzzle left on a table as everyone heads to bed"?
quests.hint: Think about what 'everyone heads to bed' tells you about the time.
quests.explanation: Yes! Everyone heading to bed tells you it's already nighttime.
quests.funFact: Some families leave a puzzle out for days, adding a few pieces every evening!

quests.instruction: "A soccer coach blowing a whistle to start warm-up drills" — when does this happen?
quests.hint: Think about when youth sports practices are usually scheduled.
quests.explanation: Yes! Youth sports practices are usually held during the day.
quests.funFact: Warming up before a game helps players avoid injuries and play their best!

quests.instruction: "A neighborhood pool, fenced and quiet, its water perfectly still" — when does this happen?
quests.hint: Think about when a usually busy pool would be completely quiet and empty.
quests.explanation: Yes! A quiet, empty pool suggests it's closed for the night.
quests.funFact: Many neighborhood pools close in the evening and reopen again the next day!

quests.instruction: Think about this: "A bakery display case being restocked with fresh pastries". Does it happen in the Daytime or the Nighttime?
quests.hint: Think about when a bakery's display case would be full for customers to see.
quests.explanation: Yes! Bakeries restock their display cases for customers during business hours, in the day.
quests.funFact: Many bakeries bake their fresh goods hours before the shop even opens!

quests.instruction: When do we see or do this: "A radio softly playing in an otherwise silent parked car"?
quests.hint: Think about when a parked car and its surroundings would be this silent.
quests.explanation: Yes! A silent, still scene like this suggests it's late at night.
quests.funFact: Some people enjoy sitting quietly in a parked car just to listen to music and relax!

quests.instruction: When do we see or do this: "A crowd cheering as a school mascot dances across the field"?
quests.hint: Think about when school games and pep rallies are usually held.
quests.explanation: Yes! School games and pep rallies are usually held during the day.
quests.funFact: School mascots help build excitement and school spirit at games and events!

quests.instruction: "A single light bulb glowing above a workbench in an empty garage" — when does this happen?
quests.hint: Think about when a garage light would need to be switched on to see clearly.
quests.explanation: Yes! A single glowing bulb suggests it's dark outside, at night.
quests.funFact: A single bright bulb can light up an entire workbench for late evening projects!

quests.instruction: "A veterinarian's office phone ringing nonstop with appointments" — when does this happen?
quests.hint: Think about when most veterinary offices are usually open.
quests.explanation: Yes! Veterinary offices are typically open and busy during the day.
quests.funFact: A busy vet's office might see anything from a goldfish to a great dane in one day!

quests.instruction: When do we see or do this: "A book left open on a chest, its reader already fast asleep"?
quests.hint: Think about when someone would fall asleep while still holding a book.
quests.explanation: Yes! Falling asleep while reading happens at night, right at bedtime.
quests.funFact: Reading before bed can help some people feel relaxed enough to drift off to sleep!
